Human gate

Every external, financial or high-stakes action — including each act of machine self-replication — passes through The Nexus: one human, one keystroke.

Bounded autonomy

The central automaton perceives, proposes and replicates inside hard budgets — cycles, proposals, workers — and freezes on a single kill switch.

Compounded capital
